source_ref.production_note: 1280x540 ultrawide ~2.37:1 (64:27) cinemascope letterbox, 29.05s, 30fps, has_audio. Live-action lifestyle footage composited over an infinite high-key white studio background, with cosmetic/supplement product cut-outs and app-screenshot UI cards floating in from frame edges, plus brand-green two-color kinetic Korean typography. Re-analyzed frame-by-frame: the long dissolve montage (4.5-15.9s) that auto-detect merges was split into real sub-cuts (paper-pile rest, yoga, cafe). Opening hook is on a DARK low-key background (not white).

target_demo: 20s-30s urban office workers / single-person households, women; busy daily life with same-day-delivery demand
narrative_arc: Dark empathy hook ('바쁘게 흘러간 오늘', bespectacled woman CU) -> white dissolve montage of daily pain points (slumped on paperwork '나를 위한 시간', yoga + floating products '좋아하는 것들로만 채우기에도', friends at cafe '모자란 하루니까') -> solution pivot (yawn '기다림은 빼고 설렘만 담아') -> app-shopping service visualization (green sofa + phone + floating app UI cards, '가장 필요한 순간 가장 빠르게 닿을 수 있도록') -> decision beat (glasses-adjust + green delivery icon) -> climax/CTA (green armchair amid towering kraft delivery parcels, '지금 주문하고, 오늘 바로.') -> green wipe to OLIVE YOUNG logo end-card
creative_device: Empathy copy about an over-busy day delivered in two-color brand-green kinetic Korean typography, set against an infinite white studio where lifestyle vignettes dissolve into one another and beauty/health products plus app-UI cards float weightlessly in — visualizing a service that 'reaches you fastest at the moment you most need it'. Pivots from pain ('subtract the waiting') to abundant payoff (a customer enthroned in brand-green amid a mountain of same-day parcels) and closes on a direct order-now CTA and the olive-O logo.

production_signature.signature_note: Live-action subjects (shallow DOF, natural light) composited over an infinite high-key white background. NOT wiggle/parallax 3D (wiggle metrics: mean_abs_shift_x 1.55, sign_flips 0.17 = low) — real motion blur and depth. Signature motion-graphics: product/app cut-outs floating from frame edges, brand-green two-color kinetic typography, dissolve transitions softening montage cut boundaries (which defeats auto cut-detection), and a green diagonal wipe into the logo.
production_signature.color_grade_note: Dominant near-pure-white high-key (#f1f0ed~#fcfafd) for most of the film, opening instead on a deliberately dark low-key hook; natural warm skin tones; brand-green (#9ba479/#9aca3c family) as the single recurring saturated accent in typography, sofa, armchair, icon and logo.

global_layout.layout_note: Subjects centered (or center-right in the hook) in vast white negative space. Kinetic Korean copy sits large on the left or mirrored left-and-right around the subject (key words in brand-green); product and app-UI cut-outs enter from the top/sides. Minimal, airy H&B-retail tone.

recurring_motifs: brand-green two-color kinetic Korean typography (key word in green)
floating product and app-screenshot UI cut-outs
bespectacled woman as the busy-everyday persona

copywriting.tagline_text: 지금 주문하고, 오늘 바로. 올리브영 오늘드림
copywriting.tagline_structure: immediacy command ('지금 주문하고' + '오늘 바로') + brand/service name ('올리브영 오늘드림')
copywriting.cta_text_structure: imperative immediacy ('지금 주문' + '오늘 바로') — the same-day-delivery core benefit
copywriting.copy_strategy: Open with empathy for an over-busy day ('바쁘게 흘러간 오늘', '나를 위한 시간', '좋아하는 것들로만 채우기에도 모자란 하루니까') to build emotional connection, pivot to the benefit with an antithesis ('기다림은 빼고 설렘만 담아' — subtract the waiting, keep only the excitement; '가장 필요한 순간 가장 빠르게 닿을 수 있도록'), then close on a direct CTA ('지금 주문하고, 오늘 바로.'). Key words popped in brand-green for kinetic rhythm. Voice and on-screen captions largely match (both).

(kraft delivery parcels stamped with green wordmark and '오늘드림' service label)

copywriting.narration_note: Voice narration and on-screen kinetic copy largely match. App-screen product/discount text and box stamps are screen-reality elements (not stored verbatim).

typography.color_strategy: Two-color kinetic: black/charcoal body with the key word in brand-green (#9ba479/#9aca3c family). High legibility against the white field (and grey-white against the dark hook).
typography.typo_motion_dominant: Key words pop/scale in brand-green ahead of the black connective syllables, assembling word by word in sync with the voice; antithesis lines ('기다림은 빼고' / '설렘만 담아', CTA '지금 주문하고,' / '오늘 바로.') are mirrored left-and-right around the central subject.

vfx.notable_vfx_note: Core VFX: (1) infinite-white compositing with cosmetic/supplement product cut-outs floating in from edges; (2) app-screenshot UI cards floating around the seated figure (service visualization, ~16-20s); (3) brand-green two-color kinetic typography throughout; (4) dissolve transitions linking the lifestyle montage (4.5-15.9s); (5) towering kraft parcel-pile composite at the climax (~22-27s); (6) brand-green diagonal wipe into the logo end-card (~27s).

audio.voice_vs_caption: Voice narration and on-screen kinetic captions largely match (both). The key copy, CTA and brand name are synced in voice and text. App-screen product/discount text is caption-only (screen reality).
audio.audio_note: faster-whisper(base): 6 segments, speech_coverage 0.568 (significant BGM). Whisper mis-hearings corrected against on-screen captions: '흘러간 오니'->'오늘'; '나를 두 번씩 하는 비선나요'->on-screen '나를 위한 시간'; '치우기'->'채우기'; '기다리면 떨둘 솔냄만 담아'->on-screen '기다림은 빼고 설렘만 담아' (KEY CORRECTION: the on-screen text reads '설렘만 담아', not the old entry's guessed '필요한 것만 담아'); '다을'->'닿을'. On-screen captions are authoritative where they disagree with whisper.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A 2.37:1 ultrawide cinemascope letterbox frame, dark and moody, opening on an extreme-to-medium close-up of a young East Asian woman wearing round thin-rimmed black eyeglasses. She is positioned to the right of center, her face turned in a three-quarter angle, eyes cast slightly upward and off-camera with a faintly weary, introspective expression — the look of someone at the tired end of an overloaded day. Her dark brown hair falls loosely past her shoulders. The lighting is deliberately low-key and dramatic for this opening beat: a single soft key from the front-left sculpts the planes of her face while the background falls off into deep shadow, near-charcoal grey-brown (#2a2622 to #1a1620), creating a contemplative, cinematic mood rather than the bright high-key look that follows later in the film. The skin reads in warm natural tones (#b89a8a highlights, #6b514a shadow). On the left third of the frame, large bold sans-serif Korean kinetic typography appears and assembles word by word; at the captured moment the full line reads, set in two tiers, the on-screen copy preserved verbatim as: top tier '바쁘게 흘러간' in a medium-weight grey-white, and below it the word '오늘' rendered larger and bolder as the emphasis word. The type is clean modern Korean gothic (sans-serif), tightly set, high-contrast against the dark field for maximum legibility. There is no product, no logo, and no other graphic element in frame — only the woman and the kinetic copy. The composition leans on generous negative space in the shadowed left and upper regions where the type breathes. The camera is essentially locked off with only the most subtle, almost imperceptible drift, lending stillness and gravity to the emotional hook. Depth of field is shallow: her near eye and glasses rims are crisp while the far side of her face and the background dissolve into soft bokeh. Fine, restrained digital grain overlays the frame; there is a faint, elegant softness to the highlights. The atmosphere is empathetic and quietly melancholic — the visual equivalent of an exhale after a long, busy day, establishing the emotional premise that the rest of the film will resolve. Color temperature is neutral-to-slightly-warm, around 5200K, with the warmth concentrated in the skin and the cool muted shadows surrounding her. The mood targets recognition and identification: a relatable, ordinary, slightly fatigued urban professional rather than an idealized glossy model — the eyeglasses functioning as a quiet signifier of a working, screen-bound, deadline-driven life. The framing reserves the right two-thirds for the subject and the left third for the copy, an asymmetric balance that feels editorial and contemporary. The letterbox bars (black, top and bottom) reinforce the cinematic, premium register. Render as a clean digital commercial frame: photographic realism, natural skin texture with visible fine detail and minimal retouch, soft directional studio-style key light, shallow focus, subtle film grain, muted desaturated palette with the only true brightness living in the highlight on her cheek and the grey-white type. The overall impression should read as the opening empathy hook of a polished Korean retail-platform lifestyle commercial — restrained, intimate, and emotionally inviting, with the kinetic Korean headline as the single graphic protagonist of the frame. The subject must be an abstracted everyday type, never a likeness of any specific real person or celebrity; facial features generic and non-identifying. No watermark, no UI, no additional text beyond the verbatim Korean copy '바쁘게 흘러간 오늘'.
